column3: The Hebrew repeats “city by city”; BSB expresses this with “each.”
The Hebrew uses the image “lifting of faces” for partiality and explicitly mentions taking a bribe; BSB says “partiality” and “bribery.”
The Hebrew says they returned to Jerusalem; BSB says they lived there.
The Hebrew says “thus you shall do” and “with a whole heart”; BSB says “serve” and “wholeheartedly.”
The Hebrew says “between blood and blood” and distinguishes law, commandment, statutes, and judgments; BSB recasts these as bloodshed or other violations.
